text:
niko: Heads-up — EU-WEST1 warm pool is pegged. 95% GPU util on pool-gpu-warm-3, sustained for ~7m and p50/p99 latency for hosted gen routes jumping from 120ms -> 550ms.
anne: seeing the same in dashboards. Many small batch spikes from tenant 'dataforge' around 09:10. KV cache miss rate for that slice shot up 8x.
mike: can someone dump the top pods in that pool? suspect the new batch job rollout.
ben: i grabbed the k8s view, looks like this: ```bash
kubectl get pods -n tenant-dataforge -l app=batch -o wide
NAME                                READY   STATUS    NODE             IP           
batch-worker-5f8d9f7c-zz9t         1/1     Running   gpu-node-euw1-12 10.2.5.12
batch-worker-5f8d9f7c-zz9u         1/1     Running   gpu-node-euw1-13 10.2.5.13
batch-worker-5f8d9f7c-zz9v         1/1     Running   gpu-node-euw1-14 10.2.5.14
``` 
ben: lots of tiny jobs (secs) hammering nvlink and egress, causing cross-tenant contention on that rack.
platform-bot: [ALERT] pool-gpu-warm-3 GPU util > 90% for 00:07:12 — auto-throttle threshold reached. Link: https://grafana.redwood/pool/pool-gpu-warm-3
tian: proposed quick mitigation: throttle tenant-dataforge to 20% of their preemptible capacity and route new hosted gen traffic to eu-west2 fallback for 10m. that should relieve the warm pool.
sre-oncall: agree. can we evict preemptible batch pods older than 2m first, then apply egress shaping? low-risk.
mike: eviction command (dry-run first): ```bash
kubectl delete pod -n tenant-dataforge --field-selector=status.phase==Running -l app=batch --grace-period=30 --force --dry-run=client
``` 
anne: doing the targeted eviction now, switching routing rule to prefer eu-west2 for tenant=hosted-gen routes.
ben: FYI cost note — routing to eu-west2 increases outbound bandwidth egress cost by ~12% for those requests. but latency p99 drops back under 200ms.
niko: good trade off for now. after relief let's schedule a follow-up: - 1) add a soft isolation slice for high-churn batch jobs - 2) tighter preemptible quotas by tenant - 3) routing policy that avoids warm pools if kvcache miss rate > 5%.
tian: i'll draft the RFC and include a sim of cost delta and expected p99 impact.
sre-oncall: monitoring in place, i'll keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
